content.text:
The longest-reigning British monarch was Queen Elizabeth II (reigned 1952–2022). Her predecessor was her father, King George VI.

I have written the answer to `answer.txt`.

Source: Search results confirming Elizabeth II as the longest-reigning monarch and George VI as her predecessor.
